text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen said she was feeling unwell during training, so I've brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It seems I was a little fatigued. I'm sorry to have worried you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But thanks to you, my mood has also rebounded. Now, shall we resume training?
choice_data_list: Nuh-uh. No training until you've fully recovered.
Not a chance. I'll have to rethink your training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But thanks to you, my mood has also rebounded. Now, shall we resume training?
choice_data_list: Nuh-uh. No training until you've fully recovered.
Not a chance. I'll have to rethink your training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You forbid it?! But I understand thoroughly how to cope with my weakened condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With a little rest, I'll surely—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Well, you're being unusually strict today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fine, then. Unfortunate as it may be, I'll do as you say and rest for the moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Stubborn ox…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to have Mejiro McQueen focus on resting for the remainder of the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What?! But you went through so much trouble to put it together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I can judge for myself whether I've reached my limits or not. This small setback is no proble—
choice_data_list: By the time you collapse, it'll be too late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I've inconvenienced you with my poor self-management… I'm truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen's injury is taking a long time to heal. Maybe her mental state has had an impact on her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This is all the result of my own inadequacies. This time, I will graciously accept my lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, I wish for my next training regimen to be stricter than this one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will get better as soon as possible, and next time, I will complete your tests without fail!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen gets better in no time, just as she declared she would. Starting the following day, she's in superb form.
